target_customer: Recruiting teams and hiring managers at companies
problem: Hiring decisions rely on resumes and gut feel; Searchlight used reference data and AI to improve quality of hire.

founders.name: Kerry Wang
founders.background_notes: Built v1 as an engineer then became first salesperson. Twin sister of Anna Wang per Multiverse coverage.

founders.name: Anna Wang
founders.background_notes: Education not given on the YC page.

competitors.name: Pymetrics
competitors.what: AI job matching using games based assessments

technical_complexity.rationale: ML on candidate and reference data with a SaaS product; standard ML engineering with data collection challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Possible data advantage but crowded category with well funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No copy documented; Multiverse bought the company in April 2024 and Kerry became Director of Product and Anna Head of AI per Multiverse coverage.

market_need_then: TechCrunch reported at least 43 AI hiring companies raised early funding in 2018 and recruiting startups raised 1.6B by Nov 2019, indicating strong spend and interest.

brand_strength.rationale: No sources on the brand; name is shared with other firms such as Searchlight Cyber. One unsourced claim says the standalone brand faded after April 2024.

outcome_analysis: Searchlight raised roughly 20M, mostly a 17M Series A in December 2021, then sold to Multiverse in April 2024 with terms undisclosed. The team joined Multiverse, so the exit looks like a strategic acquisition after a solid but not breakout path; sources disagree on who led the Series A and whether the round was 15M or 17M.
notes: Series A lead conflicts: TechCrunch says Keith Rabois led, MergerLinks and FounderLodge say Founders Fund; Pipeseed lists 15M in April 2022. Dated 2021-12 per TechCrunch. Seed date and amount unknown; Accel as seed backer per YC page. PitchBook valuation estimate of 64M (2021) was not recorded as a valuation. Website returned 503. Eightfold's round in April 2019 is just after the batch.
